coordinates.xy_axes: local phantom axes; no anatomical registration

supplemental_target.name: whole_modeled_xy_depth15_20
supplemental_target.definition: All XY cells in modeled D50 cylinder mask,15<=depth<=20mm
supplemental_target.weight: region_total_m3 times exact native z-face overlap with[15,20] divided by native dz

regions.primary_off_target: region_total_m3 minus primary target weight cell by cell
regions.supplemental_off_target: region_total_m3 minus supplemental target weight cell by cell
regions.whole_modeled_domain: Stored region_total_m3; native whole-square center-inside-cylinder mask; retain coarse staircase volume and do not silently clip to analytic circle

volume_weight_contract.cell_order: native grid rows z then y then x; NPZ vectors shape(N,)
volume_weight_contract.partial_XY: Existing r5 disk fraction from stored full-precision weights; never replace by cell-center binary mask
volume_weight_contract.partial_depth: Exact overlap using full-precision mesh z_faces_mm; no rounded CSV-derived dz
volume_weight_contract.source_npz_float_precision: Retain stored Float64 weights; no rounding or float32 conversion
volume_weight_contract.partition_validation: All weights finite/nonnegative, target<=total; respective target+off_target=total within1e-24m3+1e-12relative percell tolerance; report represented volumes and analytic deviations

scalar_definitions.waveform: Existing raw1Vpp square_3h scalar archive only
scalar_definitions.maxTIS: Fundamental3000/3030Hz two-field maximum modulation among2074 stored directions; sampled directional maximum, not a continuous-direction proof or full-harmonic envelope
scalar_definitions.fixedTIS: Existing stored fixed-direction fundamental modulation scalar; retain its source direction/convention without adding direction projections
scalar_definitions.RMS: Existing all-frequency carrier electric-field RMS for square_3h including3000,3030,9000,9090Hz; not modulation
prohibited_inferences: Do not relabel square_3h arrays as sine/triangle
Do not invent X/Y/Z modulation arrays
No new direction search or waveform synthesis

statistics.quantiles: Inverse weighted ECDF: first ascending value whose cumulative volume reaches q times total region volume

cutoffs.source: Raw1Vpp same-grid4pad baseline ROI mean andP10 for each declared ROI scope and scalar independently
cutoffs.operator: greater than or equal to cutoff (>=); include ties explicitly
cutoffs.order: Scale scalar field by candidate amplitude factor BEFORE testing cutoff; never rescale cutoff with candidate
cutoffs.reporting: Report actual threshold values, absolute surviving target modulation and complementary non-target high-volume; undefined ratio is null with reason
cutoffs.RMS_display_name: high_field_RMS; RMS threshold volume is not modulation volume

normalizations.source: 1Vpp at each nominal output before50ohm resistance; peak0.5V basis

normalizations.amplitude_factor: baseline sum(output RMS currents) / candidate sum(output RMS currents)
normalizations.current_definition: Sum of output-specific RMS currents across full stored frequency spectrum, including currents through passively terminated outputs; bookkeeping scalar, not net instantaneous/return/peak current

normalizations.power_definition: Total source real power including50ohm output resistor loss

normalizations.amplitude_factor: Minimum of8 baseline/candidate burden-derived amplitude caps; no1Vpp ceiling; exclude total source power cap
normalizations.linear_caps: J and contact voltage baseline/candidate ratio
normalizations.meaning: Numerical baseline-matched simultaneous burden caps, not human safety limits; identify active limiting cap

normalizations.amplitude_factor: min(1, all8 skin_contact_only amplitude caps, sqrt(baseline source_power_W/candidate source_power_W))
normalizations.meaning: Legacy composite additionally includes total source power and1Vpp ceiling; separate from skin_contact_only

scaling.global_shared_amplitude: One nonnegative scale on existing two-output waveform; no independent re-optimization
scaling.invalid_denominators: Fail finite nonpositive required normalization denominator rather than invent scale

regression_gates.primary_mean_P10: Reproduce stored raw primary mean/P10 for each scalar andcase from NPZ and stored weights

resources.lock: Existing .task1-execution.lock owned by root-controlled audit; both flock and POSIX lockf
resources.budget_policy: Charge actual postprocess wall time to existing ledger; effective deadline min600s and actual remaining budget; never reset or expand
resources.failure_policy: Stop and preserve outputs/checkpoint/failure evidence on gate/hash/resource error; no deletion or duplicate PDE
resources.resource_estimate_scope: Pre-execution bound estimate only,256bytes/cell for cached scalars,weights,grid,scratch; actualRSS still enforced3GiB

required_before_and_after: all consumed NPZ and native file SHAs against stored manifests
provenance.source_code_pin: Root records actual committed implementation SHA and test receipts before executing this preregistered audit
provenance.output_rule: New unique audit output only; never overwrite original NPZ/raw/summary/old failure receipts
provenance.numerically_validated_status: Only listed readback/regression/partition tests passed; convergence holds remain
provenance.native_byte_hash_scope: All consumed metadata/NPZ/probes/audit/config/mask/receipts SHA-pinned; unused E/phi native hashes copied from source summary, bytes not read during planning

retained_holds: Historical strictD source/loss componentwise reproduction failure
SC/XY/bulk/edge/contact sensitivity and candidate convergence failures
PBS interface uncertainty and missing historical full native fields
No deep-focus success from center maximum or ratio alone
No candidate adoption from this audit alone
next_decision: After7case audit compare absolute mean/P10, uniformity, matched-burden surviving target fields, off-target quantiles/hot-volume and active burden caps; root selects next finite question from evidence and reports actual start or precise blocker/resume condition
normalization_baseline_selection: Per-case exact grid/material/contact/ROI comparison_signature; no cross-grid normalization
legacy_single_baseline_key_scope: baseline_case_id is compatibility metadata only; ordered baseline_summary_paths controls actual CLI

eligibility.raw_marker_scope: availability marker only; not backup/hash/numerical validation
eligibility.acceptance_scope: controller-promoted completed calculation only; not mesh or experimental validation
